caveats: Baseline years are 1992-2002; per day-of-year the +/-5 calendar-day windows reach 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 and those days' SST values are included in the pools as the method specifies, so baseline_analysed reports the full span of baseline data actually used. Region bounds inclusive; the selected 60x60 grid block has float32 coordinates lat 59.94..61.12, lon 18.70..19.88 (neighbouring cells fall outside the bounds); 3302 of 3600 cells are sea cells (finite SST on every target day), land cells are 0. Per-cell joining was applied to runs of >=5 hot days as worded in the method; joining all short runs first would enlarge the per-cell mask but yields identical regional events. Climatology was computed as specified but plays no role in the threshold-only detection. All statistics in float64; SST compared in kelvin as stored.
